name: 60449 · Monee, IL
findings: ZIP 60449 (Monee) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60449 (Monee) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
